origin: 2026-11-10 CoMindSeed conceptual exploration; private conversation text not copied
purpose: Reconcile relational boundary, observer, inversion, null, consciousness and all-time-direction proposals with existing Golden Braid, CoTheoryAll, CoTime and CoEvo provenance, without a second truth store.

concepts.claim: If two world descriptions give identical admissible observations, their distinction is not empirically established by those observations.
concepts.challenge: Specify a discriminating observation or prove equivalence only under a stated model.

concepts.claim: All, Nothing, their inversions and G_d may be explored as perspectives; literal identity is not a physical result.
concepts.challenge: Define the transformation and ask what remains invariant without making every assertion vacuously true.

concepts.claim: A proposed nonquantum substrate might yield quantum-like observations under boundary-dependent projections.
concepts.challenge: State dynamics and predict interference and Bell-type correlations without ad hoc measurement dependence; compare with ordinary quantum models.

concepts.claim: Bounded systems may perform distinction, integration, memory, adaptation and self-modeling in different degrees.
concepts.challenge: Perturb internal causal organization and evaluate preregistered task outcomes against matched controls.

concepts.claim: Functional observation and boundary regulation alone do not demonstrate subjective experience.
concepts.challenge: Compare rival consciousness theories and independent evidence standards; prohibit a subjective-experience PASS based on router output.

placement_rules.rule: Exact source, event and observation evidence; never silently rewrite original witness.
Retain alternatives, assumptions, falsifier or discriminating question and source provenance.
Preserve as symbolic/philosophical interpretation, without empirical, causal or authorization claims.
Freeze issued_at, assumptions and prediction; later observation calibrates as a different event.
Retrospective what-if never changes event_at or a source witness.
Missing/unseen/withheld/absent remain different; no forced false or zero.

hard_gates: work identity matches and source provenance is appropriate
epistemic and temporal class route only to compatible primary anchor
source event timestamp and forecast issuance remain frozen
inverse lookup cannot imply reciprocal causal power
no writes, publishing, worker execution or authority inferred
binding_algorithm.ranking: Among hard-gate-qualified anchors, maximize integer provenance+meaning+time+recovery+receiver fit minus risk and cost, only as a candidate proposal; no universal optimality or automatic promotion.
non_triggers: repetition of the same user assent

acceptance: Run standard-library fixture tests with competing authorized and unauthorized anchors.
Read back exact branch bytes and commit SHA before declaring source landed.
Independent reviewer reproduces one past->current->possible-future trace with inverse lookup and reports which interpretation survived.
Observed facts, hypothetical quantum substrate, interpretive G_d and consciousness claims remain separate.
No user-facing MVP or receiver ACK until real client acceptance and restart/rollback tests.
